performance.scope: Native SBCL complete upstream Drei buffer-performance-tests suite; not Valtan
performance.script:
(require :asdf)
(load (merge-pathnames #p"quicklisp/setup.lisp" (user-homedir-pathname)))
(pushnew :clim-without-swank *features*)
(asdf:load-system "st-json")
(asdf:load-system "drei-mcclim/test")
(let* ((fiveam:*on-error* nil) (fiveam:*on-failure* nil)
       (results (fiveam:run 'drei-tests::buffer-performance-tests))
       (passed (count-if #'fiveam::test-passed-p results))
       (skipped (count-if #'fiveam::test-skipped-p results))
       (failed (- (length results) passed skipped)))
 (with-open-file (out "/tmp/valtan-drei-native-performance.json" :direction :output :if-exists :supersede)
  (st-json:write-json
   (st-json:jso "scope" "Native SBCL complete upstream Drei buffer-performance-tests suite; not Valtan"
                "passed" passed "failed" failed "skipped" skipped
                "nonpassed" (loop for result in results unless (fiveam::test-passed-p result)
                                  collect (st-json:jso "test" (prin1-to-string (fiveam::name (fiveam::test-case result)))
                                                       "reason" (fiveam::reason result)))) out))
 (unless (zerop failed) (uiop:quit 1)))
